candidates.old:
cm_x_max_low_operand = * + 1
    LDA #&00                        \ actually LDA #mover_x_max_low, set above: right of the range: x > the range's right (the original's
    CMP movers_x_low,X              \ own first test)
cm_x_max_high_operand = * + 1
    LDA #&00                        \ actually LDA #mover_x_max_high, set above
    SBC movers_x_high,X
    BCC cm_right_next               \ grind: right of the range: the hot path, taken
candidates.new:
cm_x_max_high_operand = * + 1
    LDA #&00                        \ actually LDA #mover_x_max_high, set above: right of the range: x > the range's right (the original's
    CMP movers_x_high,X             \ own first test), the high bytes first: the common case is decided here
    BCC cm_right_next               \ grind: right of the range by a page or more: the hot path, taken
    BNE cm_not_right                \ the range's right is a page or more right of x: not right of it
cm_x_max_low_operand = * + 1
    LDA #&00                        \ actually LDA #mover_x_max_low, set above: the same page: the low bytes
    CMP movers_x_low,X
    BCC cm_right_next               \ grind: right of the range: x > the range's right
candidates.summary: Right-of-range test in the collision search's hot loop done high byte first: x_high > range_high (78% of the tests, none with x_high < range_high) is decided by LDA #/CMP abs,X/BCC taken (15 cycles an iteration with the CPX, down from 21); only an equal high byte goes on to the low-byte compare. Same decision (x > max, 16-bit) as the LDA/CMP/LDA/SBC pair. Measured on the bench build copy: 303 cycles a pass less on seed 1 (34422 -> 34119), 286 holding RIGHT (39623 -> 39337), state and screen identical to the control over 3000 passes (passlock).
candidates.equivalence: Old: right-of-range iff max_high:max_low < x_high:x_low as a 16-bit compare (CMP low sets C, SBC high; BCC = max < x). New: LDA #max_high / CMP x_high,X: C=0 iff max_high < x_high => right, the same BCC cm_right_next. Else if max_high != x_high (BNE: then max_high > x_high, x is more than a page left of the range's right) not right: go to cm_not_right (x_high < max_high must not be skipped, a mover just under a page boundary is in range, so BNE is needed, not a fall into the low test). Else equal high bytes: LDA #max_low / CMP x_low,X: C=0 iff max_low < x_low => right (BCC cm_right_next), else fall into cm_not_right. Same three outcomes as the 16-bit test. Exits and entries: cm_right_next, cm_not_right and the loop head are unchanged; the loop head is still reached from check_next_mover by BNE; nothing in cm_not_right/check_in_full reads A, C, Z or N from the right test (cm_not_right starts with LDA movers_x_low,X; CMP; LDA; SBC; check_in_full starts with CPX). A at routine exit is unchanged: the last full check always runs through JSR check_for_collision_with_mover (the last two movers X < last_mover+3 bypass the prefilter) or is the self-skip, whose A comes from the previous full check, never from the right test (both of the last two cannot be mover_to_update, and a right-skipped mover has X >= last_mover+3). Y, &78, &7A, X, C at exit are the checks' as before. cm_x_max_low_operand and cm_x_max_high_operand keep their roles: the same two STAs before the window patch the same two immediates (operand labels swap order in the code, labels still = * + 1 of an LDA #); no other reference to either in src/. Equal-high cost: right 25 vs 21 (+4, 9.6 a pass), not right 22 vs 20 (+2, 7.1 a pass), both included in the net 303/286 measured.
candidates.relies_on: The window's measured mix: 60.8 of 77.5 right-of-range tests a pass are decided by the high byte alone (x_high > range_high), 9.6 more are equal-high and right, 7.1 equal-high and not right, none x_high < range_high (instrumented on the bench build, seed 1, 1500 passes; the BNE path is correct but never taken there). Code is +4 bytes (16 vs 12 for the test): everything after slides 4 bytes (the code up to &333F; free space 193 -> 189). Page crossings: the hot loop (bench build &24C8-&24DB), check_next_mover and its BNE back, set_cm_left (STA cm_left_low now at &2500-&2502, same instructions, no branch crossing) all stay within page &24/&25 with no taken branch crossing a page; the bench build with this change measured 303 (seed 1) and 286 (RIGHT) cycles a pass fewer than HEAD's in a worktree copy, so any later page-crossing move from the 4-byte slide is already in that figure. Self-modifying code: the STA to cm_x_max_high_operand/cm_x_max_low_operand at the routine's start must still land on the LDA # operands, which they do (assembler labels). Builds assembling: bench (DEBUG_LIVES), default, SKY_HELI=0, gameplay.
